entries.0395c5147d6a9b2e: Description of the structure and characteristics of each business in 'Business Overview'
entries.045d01b7226d1e47: It provides burn-in equipment and boards for semiconductor testing in the Electronic Systems Business, LSI design and IP cores in the Microelectronics Business, and imaging-related equipment such as camera modules in the Product Development Business.
entries.0cb1897fbf64d3a3: The company develops IP cores, which are circuit information for LSIs grouped by a single function. It provides services ranging from licensing IP cores such as JPEG, MIPI and ISP to designing peripheral circuits and customizing them.
entries.126b507848cf25b0: It manufactures burn-in equipment and boards for semiconductor testing, carries out LSI design and IP core development, and develops and manufactures imaging equipment such as CMOS camera modules.

entries.1d2fd5cc14c600a7: This business develops and manufactures equipment and systems that use imaging technology.
entries.20a9a45adfe0f515: This business handles inspection-related equipment and devices used in semiconductor manufacturing plants.
entries.28a9d5e1107b62a2: These are industrial embedded cameras, image-processing cameras, CMOS camera modules, image-processing systems and image-processing modules.
entries.2ab2a3776d2b3d24: Sales of imaging equipment and system development
entries.2bed39236a902a11: These are industrial embedded cameras, image-processing cameras, CMOS camera modules, image-processing systems and image-processing modules. They are used for a variety of applications, including image inspection, measurement and various recognition processing.
entries.32bff24199af032a: This business designs LSIs for semiconductors and develops IP cores.
entries.3c96567567157a74: This is the development and manufacture of monitoring equipment that applies camera system technology. It is working to raise added value, including by strengthening integration with nursing care software and improving operability from the user's perspective.
entries.4075daadc66c4366: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, inventory adjustments for automotive semiconductors weighed on back-end semiconductor products in the Electronic Systems Business, and a decline in domestic mass-production shipments also affected the Product Development Business. On the other hand, orders for custom burn-in boards for image sensors rose significantly, and in the Microelectronics Business, contract LSI design for next-generation electric vehicles remained firm, so results were mixed across the businesses.
entries.4741e6ce2da76c1a: Analog and digital LSI design. It designs power ICs, high-speed interfaces, image sensors, image-processing LSIs, FPGAs and ASICs, and dispatches design engineers.
entries.47959fcf63b7c71d: Its medium-term management plan for fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027 sets four basic management policies: strengthening the competitiveness of its core businesses; creating new technologies and new products and commercializing them early; expanding into new markets and global business; and utilizing digital infrastructure and developing human resources. Its vision is to propose and realize solutions that society needs in 'measurement', 'devices' and 'cameras'.
entries.4e866d9853613cfa: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,485 million, down 0.5% from the previous fiscal year. The breakdown is Electronic Systems Business ¥3,059 million, Microelectronics Business ¥2,121 million and Product Development Business ¥1,303 million.
entries.668738457b041d60: This business handles inspection-related equipment and devices used in semiconductor manufacturing plants. In addition to developing and manufacturing peripheral equipment and jigs, such as burn-in equipment and burn-in boards used to evaluate and test semiconductor components and semiconductor test programs, it also develops, designs and manufactures inspection boards, dedicated measuring instruments and various electronic equipment for industrial customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,059 million.
entries.696f9bbaecdf90c9: Semiconductor component inspection boards and test programs
entries.6d70a1cd35550a2a: Its customers include semiconductor manufacturers, consumer electronics and automotive-related manufacturers, and industrial equipment manufacturers, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation accounted for 10.8% of total net sales.

entries.77a5ce1df3ca66b3: A manufacturer in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, that develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection equipment, LSI design, and image-related equipment.
entries.7a2453123b4eea28: Net loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥109 million, the second consecutive year of losses following the previous year's net loss of ¥14 million.

entries.8d411e11fb34ac19: Equipment used for burn-in testing, which operates semiconductors at higher temperatures than normal to remove initial failures, and boards with peripheral circuits that operate semiconductors. The company also rents out burn-in equipment.
entries.972f573eac476eaa: Shikino High-Tech CO.,LTD. is a stand-alone company headquartered in Uozu City, Toyama Prefecture. As of March 31, 2026, it had 435 employees, and it sets out as its mission 'creating new value through technology and contributing to the realization of a safe, secure and efficient society'.
entries.99481bc75af73eea: Its strength lies in its wide range of in-house semiconductor and imaging technologies, from semiconductor testing equipment to LSI design, IP cores and camera modules. In LSI design, it has built an integrated structure from circuit design through to the creation of test programs, and in product development, integrated production at its domestic in-house factory equipped with a dedicated cleanroom enables it to achieve high reliability and stable supply over the medium to long term.
entries.9cf7042f99ce32cf: Equipment used for burn-in testing, which operates semiconductors at higher temperatures than normal to remove initial failures, and boards with peripheral circuits that operate semiconductors.
entries.ad48cee7ae8b6219: This business designs LSIs for semiconductors and develops IP cores. In analog, it has an integrated design structure covering circuit design, layout design, characterization and creation of test programs, and it also dispatches design engineers. In digital, it designs mainly image processing and high-speed interfaces, and it also licenses and customizes original IP cores based on image processing technology. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,121 million.
entries.b9d5aec6748afae6: CMOS camera modules and image processing systems

entries.d0c834493d4cbd2a: Contract development, design and manufacturing of electronic equipment
entries.d7b0040ca9b5b9fb: This business develops and manufactures equipment and systems that use imaging technology. At its in-house domestic factory, which has a dedicated clean room, it carries out integrated production of industrial embedded cameras, image-processing cameras, CMOS camera modules and image-processing systems that can perform complex image processing within the camera itself. It also develops and manufactures monitoring equipment that applies camera system technology. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,303 million.
